_readme: Values for every {{PLACEHOLDER}} in topical-map.md. Any value beginning with TODO must be filled by John before the page that uses it ships. Claude Code must render TODO values as visible markers, never invent them.
UNLOAD_POLICY: Your driver coordinates with you on the best or preferred place to unload.
PAYMENT_POLICY: You see the total with a cost breakdown before you request. Your card is authorized when you request and charged when the driver marks the trip complete. The driver receives DRIVER_SHARE of the fare directly; the rest goes to BoxHauls, LLC.
HEAVY_FEE_ITEMS: refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, gun safes, sectionals and sleeper sofas
TIER_MODEL: Tiers are job types, not truck sizes. Every tier uses the same price formula.
OTHER_FEES: None. No minimum fare, no stairs fee, no wait-time fee, no surge.
HELPER_POLICY: A second helper is optional and costs $17. It is available only when the matched driver brings a helper and accepts a job that requests one. BoxHauls does not guarantee a helper will be available.

SERVICE_CENTER._note: Downtown Fresno. Both addresses must be within RADIUS miles of this point.

_no_show_note: When the customer can report a driver no-show: ASAP trips NO_SHOW_ASAP_MINUTES after the driver accepted; scheduled trips once the time window has ended. Default set by Claude: confirm.
WEATHER_POLICY: Weather calls are at the driver's discretion. If a driver cancels for weather, your card hold is released right away and you pay nothing.
DRIVER_CANCEL_POLICY: If your driver cancels or doesn't show up, your card hold is released right away and you pay nothing.
_payments_note: Card holds last 7 days (Stripe, customer-initiated), so scheduling is capped at BOOKING_DAYS_AHEAD = 6. On dump runs the hold adds the estimated dump fee from DUMP_FEES (material + load size); the driver enters the actual gate fee (up to that estimate) at completion.

DUMP_FEES._source: Owner-provided local rates, October 2026 (from search results). Confirm with each site before launch.
